heading: Book Your Consultation
intro: Tell us a little about yourself and {doctorName} will personally follow up to plan your consultation.

trust.welcomeBody: This is a real conversation with {doctorName}, not an automated intake — she reviews every request personally before your first session.
trust.labTestsNote: If lab tests are needed, she'll let you know after reviewing your request.
trust.inbodyNote: You can get an InBody body-composition scan at most pharmacies if you'd like to bring one.

form.name: Full name
form.message: What would you like help with?
form.messageOptional: What would you like help with? (optional)
form.messagePlaceholder: Tell us a bit about your goals, or anything you'd like the doctor to know before your session.

validation.nameMinLength: Name must be at least 2 characters
validation.phoneInvalid: Please enter a valid phone number
validation.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address

success.heading: Request received
success.body: Thank you, {name} — your request has been saved and {doctorName} will personally follow up with you soon.
success.whatsappHint: Send a quick message now so the conversation starts right away.

error.heading: We couldn't send your request
error.body: Something went wrong on our end. Your information hasn't been lost — please try again.
